fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) rose +639.3% over 12 months, with earnings swinging from net losses to substantial profits that have kept pace with stock gains, trading at a trailing P/E of 16.8x versus S&P 500's 22.6x, indicating undervaluation.
fields.summary_ko.1: SanDisk's data center revenue grew +437% YoY, becoming the highest-growth segment of total revenue, with future revenue of $9.39 billion locked in through multi-year supply contracts of 4+ years.
